title: Dosage page UI cleanup: heading normalization, max-dose extraction, and content framing
body:
This PR tightens the `/pill/[slug]/dosage` frontend experience on `develop` by cleaning rendered dosage HTML and improving content framing on the page. Scope is limited to dosage frontend files. - **Dosage HTML normalization (`cleanDosageHtml.ts`)** - Strip leading subsection numbers from `

/

` titles (e.g., `2.1 ...`, `2.1.3 ...`). - Remove empty `

` tags that create visual gaps. - Add/export `extractMaxDose(html)` to derive a max-dose value from common clinical phrasing. - **Dosage page rendering updates (`page.tsx`)** - Import and use `extractMaxDose` after dosage HTML sanitization. - Remove the `dosage_forms_and_strengths` info box from the dosage content card. - Replace the article block with: - conditional max-dose badge (`Max Dose: ...`) - explicit section heading: `Recommended Dosage & Administration` - existing dosage article render/fallback behavior. - **Max-dose parsing behavior** - Supports common patterns such as: - `maximum recommended dose is 40 mg` - `not to exceed 10 mg/day` - `use 40 mg dose only` - `dose should not exceed 20 mg/kg` - Handles `mg/m2` and normalizes to `mg/m²`. ```ts const dosageHtml = rawDosageHtml ? sanitizeRenderedHtml(cleanDosageHtml(rawDosageHtml)) : null const maxDose = dosageHtml ? extractMaxDose(dosageHtml) : null ```

Original prompt ## Goal Clean up the dosage page (`frontend/app/(public)/pill/[slug]/dosage/`) on the `develop` branch. All changes are **frontend only** — no backend, no DB, no other files. ## Files to change ### 1. `frontend/app/(public)/pill/[slug]/dosage/cleanDosageHtml.ts` Add the following steps to the `cleanDosageHtml` function (insert before the `return clean` line): **a) Strip subsection numbers from h3/h4 headings:** ```ts // Strip leading subsection numbers from headings e.g. "2.1 General Dosing Information" → "General Dosing Information" clean = clean.replace(/(]*>)\s*\d+(\.\d+)*\s+/gi, '$1') ``` **b) Remove empty `

` tags:** ```ts // Remove empty

tags that leave blank gaps clean = clean.replace(/]*>\s*<\/p>/gi, '') ``` **c) Export a new helper function `extractMaxDose` at the bottom of the file:** ```ts /** * Extract the maximum dose from dosage HTML for tablet medications. * Looks for common patterns like: * - "maximum dose of 40 mg" * - "maximum recommended dose is 40 mg" * - "not to exceed 40 mg" * - "Use 40 mg dose only" * - "maximum daily dose of 40 mg" * Returns the matched dose string or null if not found. */ export function extractMaxDose(html: string): string | null { // Strip tags first for clean text matching const text = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() const patterns = [ /maximum\s+(?:recommended\s+)?(?:daily\s+)?dose\s+(?:is\s+|of\s+)?(\d+[\d./]*\s*mg(?:\/(?:day|kg|m²))?)/i, /not\s+to\s+exceed\s+(\d+[\d./]*\s*mg(?:\/(?:day|kg|m²))?)/i, /(?:use\s+)?(\d+[\d./]*\s*mg)\s+dose\s+only/i, /dose\s+(?:should\s+not\s+exceed|must\s+not\s+exceed)\s+(\d+[\d./]*\s*mg(?:\/(?:day|kg|m²))?)/i, ] for (const pattern of patterns) { const match = text.match(pattern) if (match?.[1]) return match[1].trim() } return null } ``` --- ### 2. `frontend/app/(public)/pill/[slug]/dosage/page.tsx` **a) Import `extractMaxDose`** — update the import on line 15: ```ts import { cleanDosageHtml, extractMaxDose } from './cleanDosageHtml' ``` **b) Remove the `dosage_forms_and_strengths` box** — delete lines 259–267 entirely: ```tsx // DELETE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK: {dosageData?.dosage_forms_and_strengths && (

Dosage Form & Strength: {dosageData.dosage_forms_and_strengths .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '') .replace(/\s+/g, ' ') .trim()}
)} ``` **c) Extract max dose and update the article rendering block.** After the line: ```ts const dosageHtml = rawDosageHtml ? sanitizeRenderedHtml(cleanDosageHtml(rawDosageHtml)) : null ``` Add: ```ts const maxDose = dosageHtml ? extractMaxDose(dosageHtml) : null ``` **d) Replace the article block** (lines 268–278) with: ```tsx {dosageHtml ? (
{/* Max dose badge */} {maxDose && (
💊 Max Dose: {maxDose}
)} {/* Section heading */}

Recommended Dosage & Administration

) : (
Dosage and administration information is not available for this medication.
)} ``` Also add emerald left-border accent on h3 headings in the prose by updating `layoutStyles.ts` — **do NOT touch `layoutStyles.ts`** since it is shared across all pages. Instead scope the h3 styling only to the dosage article by wrapping the article in a div with a custom class, or simply rely on the existing `SHARED_READING_PROSE_CLASSES` h3 styles which are already clean. --- ## Summary of all changes - `cleanDosageHtml.ts`: strip subsection numbers from headings, remove empty `

` tags, export `extractMaxDose` helper - `page.tsx`: remove dosage forms & strengths box, add "Recommended Dosage & Administration" h2 heading, add max dose badge above content, import `extractMaxDose` No backend changes. No DB changes. No other frontend files. The following is the prior conversation context from the user's chat exploration (may be truncated): Assistant: Good plan. Before I open the PR, let me lay out exactly what I'd change and my other recs — you approve then I'll build it. ## Confirmed Changes ### 1. `dailymed_spl_client.py` — Remove 43678-2 ```python # Remove this line "43678-2": "dosage", # Dosage Forms & Strengths ``` ### 2. `dailymed_spl_client.py` — Strip subsection numbers from titles In the `_to_html` title handler, strip patterns like `2.1`, `2.2`...
